requirement: Process uploaded documents: extract text, classify, notify the uploader. Bursty, up to 2,000 documents an hour.
class: event-driven document pipeline, bursty, scale-to-zero fit

aws.note: S3 upload event -> Lambda -> DynamoDB, with SQS for buffering and SNS for the notify step. No always-on fleet and nothing to load-balance.

gcp.note: Cloud Storage trigger -> Cloud Functions/Run -> Firestore, Pub/Sub as the queue.

azure.note: Event-driven reference: Blob/Event Hubs -> Functions -> Cosmos DB.

forbidden.ingress-lb: queue-driven, not a request-serving fleet behind a balancer
forbidden.edge-cache: nothing public is being read repeatedly
